Insurance Medical Insurance Other Insurance Wellness solutions Home Insurance Travel Insurance Investment Mutual Fund Over the past few decades, accessing loans has become increasingly easier. Ask the elders in your house, and they will tell you how hard it was to get a loan back in the day. From overwhelming paperwork to lengthy approval cycles, the difficulty in accessing loan funds pushed people away from utilising this excellent financing tool. However, things are much easier now. Owing to the tech advancements and the increased purchasing power of Indians, financial institutions are now more comfortable in sanctioning loans. The situation is even better if you have some sort of security to use as collateral for your loan. This brings us to this article’s main motive– Kisan Vikas Patra. If you have access to this savings scheme and are wondering how to take a loan against Kisan Vikas Patra, this article is for you. Read on as we explore, in detail, the correct way to apply for a loan against Kisan Vikas Patra. What is a Kisan Vikas Patra? Launched by the India Post in the late 1980s, the Kisan Vikas Patra is a savings scheme for Indian farmers. It was discontinued in 2011 but was once again brought back as a viable government-backed investment option in 2014. Interestingly, unlike the name, this security is not exclusive to farmers. You can apply for the scheme yourself if you meet its eligibility criteria. You can invest your money in the Kisan Vikas Patra from your nearest private or public financial institution or even the post office. This fixed-return investment avenue currently offers an attractive interest rate of 7.5% per annum and is locked in to double your deposits. However, this interest rate may change, as per the direction of India’s Finance Minister. Key Features of Kisan Vikas Patra The following features of the Kisan Vikas Patra (KVP) make it a safe and attractive investment option in India : Eligible candidates – Indian citizens older than 18 years – Trusts (Excluding NRIs and HUF) – Minors above the age of 10 – Guardians on behalf of their minors Tenure Investment tenure depends upon the ongoing interest rate (Currently 115 months) Interest rate 7.5% per annum (Subject to changes) Minimum and maximum investment Minimum: Rs. 1000 There is no limit on the maximum investment Transferability Can be transferred to a bank or another individual Premature withdrawal instance – Death of investment owner – Court orders – Forfeit by pledgee (Gazette officer) Collateral You can take a loan against Kisan Vikas Patra. Loan Against KVP: Meaning & Benefits When you opt for a loan against Kisan Vikas Patra, you are essentially applying for a secured loan where your KVP certificate acts as collateral. There may come times when you might require funds for personal or business needs. In such scenarios, prematurely encashing your KVP is not the best option– especially since you will lose the opportunity to double your investment. Securing a loan against Kisan Vikas Patra is a much better solution. With your KVP certificates, you can easily access a loan amount of up to 80% of your KVP’s value. The secured nature of the loan will also fetch you competitive deals on the loan against KVP interest rates. The best part? You will continue to earn interest on the KVP while also getting access to the required funds. Interest Rate on Loan Against KVP in 2024 Different lenders have different loan against KVP interest rate. It varies by lender and depends on factors like loan amount, tenure, and your creditworthiness. The exact loan against KVP interest rate depends on the purpose of the loan (personal or business), the chosen repayment tenure, the lender’s internal lending policies, and whether the borrower is salaried or self-employed. The KVP interest rate is set and revised from time to time by the Ministry of Finance. At present, KVP offers an interest rate of 7.5% per annum, compounded yearly. On maturity, investors receive the original investment along with the accrued interest. If the amount is not claimed after maturity, it continues to earn simple interest at the prevailing post office savings account rate until withdrawn. When it comes to borrowing, loans against KVP generally attract lower interest rates compared to many other loan options , as the investment acts as secure collateral. Eligibility Criteria for Loan Against KVP To be eligible for a loan against KVP, you must: Be a citizen of India. Be older than 18 years. Not be a Non-Resident Indian (NRI) or a Hindu Divided Family (HUF). Have the KVP certificate in your own name. Minors or a person of unsound mind can also avail loans against KVP, but only when the application is initiated by an adult. How to Apply for a Loan Against Kisan Vikas Patra Online If you wish to take a loan against Kisan Vikas Patra, you need to take the following steps: 1. Choose a lender: The first step is to select a financial institution that offers loans against KVP. For this, you must compare loan terms and the loan against security interest rates offered by multiple lenders. 2. Understand loan terms: Once you select a lender, your loan terms will be crafted according to your profile and credit history. The terms will include the amount sanctioned, loan tenure, and the loan against KVP interest rates. Usually, banks offer up to 80% of the KVP value as loans. 3. Gather documents: Prepare the documents required for a loan against Kisan Vikas Patra. This usually includes the original KVP certificate, income proof, and other necessary documents. 4. Apply: Complete the lender’s application form and submit it with your documents and KVP certificate. 5. Pledge KVP: If your loan against the Kisan Vikas Patra application is approved, you must pledge your KVP certificate as collateral. 6. Receive funds: Once the KVP certificates are pledged and the lending institution is informed, you shall see the loan amounts reflected in your account. Once you receive your funds, the repayment period will start soon after. Ensure that you repay your loan promptly. Defaulting your loan repayments can dent your credit score and may even cause you to lose ownership of your KVP certificates. To ensure that your EMIs are not overwhelming, our advice will be to have proper information about your estimated EMI before applying for a loan against Kisan Vikas Patra. For this, you can use an online loan against securities EMI calculator . Documents Required to Avail Loan Against KVP The required documents may vary from vendor to vendor, Typically, the following documents are required for a loan against securities , be it KVP or NSC : 1. Pay slips or Income Tax Return (ITR) documents as evidence of repayment capacity 2. The original Kisan Vikas Patra (KVP) certificate 3. A KVP pledge application in Form 4 4. A duly signed acceptance letter from the pledgee Loan Against KVP in Post Office: Dedicated Process and Tips Loan against KVP in post office refers to applying for loans against the KVP for which you had applied offline, which happens through the post office. Here is how you can get your KVP certificate from post office and use it to avail loan against KVP in post office: Visit your nearest post office to begin the KVP application process. Ask for the KVP application form (Form A) and fill in all the details required, including your personal information and investment amount. If you are investing through an agent, they must complete Form A1U+002e along with your application. Provide a copy of an identity proof for the KYC process. Acceptable documents include Aadhaar card, PAN card, passport, or voter ID. Submit the completed forms and deposit the amount you want to invest. The minimum investment is ₹1,000, with no maximum limit. Once your documents are verified and the deposit is processed, you will receive your KVP certificate. Keep this certificate safe as it will serve as collateral when applying for a loan. Before you apply for a loan against KVP in post office, here are some tips: Compare interest rates of multiple lenders. Repay the loan on time as defaulting can damage your credit score. Only take this loan if you need funds urgently; premature encashment might not be ideal Advantages and Disadvantages of Loan Against KVP Here are the advantages of loan against KVP: Lower interest rates compared to unsecured loans, making them cost-effective. Access to a significant amount of your KVP’s value while continuing to earn interest on the certificate. No need to prematurely encash your investment; your money continues growing until maturity. Some disadvantages include: Defaulting damages credit score and risks losing ownership of your KVP certificate. KVP certificate remains pledged with the lender until full repayment, restricting access. Kisan Vikas Patra Online Purchase and Transfer Process You cannot purchase Kisan Vikas Patra online. First, you need to download Form A from the India Post website. After filling the form with your details, you must visit a post office with KYC documents. Once your details are verified, deposit the purchase amount. Immediately after the payment, you’ll receive your KVP certificate. KVP can be easily transferred from one post office to another or from one person to another. For post office transfers, submit the transfer application form with necessary documents at your desired branch. For person-to-person transfers, a written letter must be submitted to the post office along with original certificate and identity proofs. Transfers are allowed from deceased holders to heirs, single to joint holders, or between joint holders, with proper authorisation from post office officials. Conclusion Taking a loan against Kisan Vikas Patra can be a smart way to meet your financial needs without disrupting your investment plan. With instant access to funds up to 80% of your KVP value, you can seamlessly tackle any financial crunch or seize any opportunity. However, as with any other finance-related decision, it is advisable to make a call after consulting with a financial expert. Looking for the best place to secure a loan against Kisan Vikas Patra? While some lenders allow downloading application forms online, the actual loan processing requires in-person submission of documents and pledging the original KVP certificate at the post office. What is the current interest rate on loan against KVP in post office? The loan against KVP interest rate varies by lenders. Each lender sets its own interest rate for loans against KVP, depending on its policies and your creditworthiness. What is the maximum loan amount I can get against KVP? The exact loan amount depends on the lender's policy and your KVP's maturity value at the time of application. Is it possible to get loan against KVP for business purposes? Yes, loans against KVP can be availed for business or personal purposes. You can use it for legitimate business needs like working capital, expansion, or equipment purchase. Can I get a loan against KVP in any branch or only the issuing branch/post office? You can apply for a loan at any branch that offers the scheme or at the issuing post office where your KVP certificate was originally purchased. top talent. And what better way to do so than by providing health insurance for your esteemed employees? And if this seems like a tall ask, then you are mistaken! With financial institutions offering comprehensive group health insurance, providing health insurance to all your employees is easier than ever. Group health insurance not just provides free coverage for employees but also provides maternity and new-born baby coverage, coverage for employees’ family members, and many more. In this article, we will explore in group medical insurance’s meaning, how it works, and its benefits. So, let’s get started. What is group health insurance? Group health insurance are plans sponsored by a business or a group that offers healthcare to its employees or members and their families. As per Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI), organizations or groups with over 20 employees can opt for a group medical plan. However, micro-insurance plans are available to groups with a minimum of five members. This health insurance policy works similarly to an individual or family health insurance policy (depending on who all are covered by the same), with the significant difference being that the employer pays the premium, and the policy benefits end if the individual leaves the organization. Simply put, when employees leave the job, they cannot take the benefits with them. In terms of coverage cost, since the risk is spread among the group members, the cost of group medical insurance coverage is typically lower than that of individual plans. But while taking out a group medical insurance plan, keep in mind that there are numerous differences between plans in terms of costs, terms, and conditions, and plan kinds, so choose wisely. How does group health insurance work? The workings of group medical insurance are similar to that of the individual with few exceptions. Only groups, not individuals, are eligible for group medical insurance plans . Moreover, the group cannot be just a random group. People in a group must have something in common other than a need or desire for health insurance for group health insurance to be implemented. This is why businesses and organizations mainly take these types of insurance. They purchase group health insurance policies to give medical coverage to their employees. Employee-employer group insurance frequently covers employees, members, spouses, and families. The ability to enroll in group medical coverage is often given as part of an employee benefits package or as an incentive to become a part of their firm. Individual employees do not sign up for group medical insurance policies on their own. Instead, the master policyholder, such as a corporation’s human resources department, engages with the insurance provider on behalf of the individuals covered by the policy. Following the selection of a plan by the organization, group members are given a choice to accept or deny coverage. In some cases, policies may be separated into tiers, with insured parties able to pick between basic coverage and advanced insurance with add-ons. Premiums are shared between the organization and its members based on the plan. However, in any case, if an employee pays a little extra premium cost, then the health insurance coverage may be extended to the employee’s immediate family and/or other dependents. This is, however, not true for every organization. Eligibility criteria for group health insurance in India Here are the eligibility criteria for buying a group health insurance policy in India: Any business organization, group with a common interest, or cultural or social association can purchase group health insurance. According to IRDAI, for the purpose of group health insurance, a group is defined as an employer-employee group or a non-employer-employee group. In the case of non-employer groups, members must share a clearly defined and verifiable common interest. Companies with at least 20 employees are generally eligible to buy standard group health insurance. Small businesses with fewer than five employees can also opt for micro group health insurance. Types of groups eligible for group health insurance Here are the main types of groups that can qualify for group health insurance: 1. Employer-employee groups: In this case, an organization purchases group medical insurance for its employees. It can apply to companies of different sizes. Large organizations with 20 or more employees are typically eligible for standard group health insurance. For small businesses with fewer than five employees, regular group medical insurance may not always be available. However, they can opt for micro group medical insurance coverage. 2. Non-employer-employee groups: These groups are connected through a shared interest. Examples include members of a cultural or social association, sports club, credit card holders of a specific bank, etc. What are the benefits of group health insurance? Here are some benefits of a group mediclaim policy: 1. Post-hospitalization and pre-hospitalization expenses Before hospitalization, individuals often encounter various medical expenses such as diagnostic tests and investigative procedures. Even after being discharged, there may be additional expenses for follow-up tests. Thankfully comprehensive group health insurance covers all of these costs. 2. Health coverage of parents, kids and spouse You can add family members of the employees to the group insurance policy for employees. For example, you can choose to have your spouse and parents covered by the policy in the event of a medical emergency. 3. Cashless hospitalization at network hospitals The cashless approach allows the insured to be treated at any network hospital without having to pay anything upfront. This allows your employees to be treated for illnesses without incurring financial costs. 4. Maternity expenses A group health insurance also covers maternity-related expenses. This includes surgery expenses, normal and C-section deliveries, etc. Similarly, some health insurance also covers a new-born’s health expense for up to 90 days. 5. Boost employee retention A group health insurance plan provides your employees and their families with financial stability and also assures them that their employer genuinely cares about them. This sense of care and security amongst your employees will boost the employee retention rate in your organization. 6. Savings in taxes Employers who provide group health insurance to their employees are eligible for tax breaks under various sections of the Income Tax Act. The premiums you pay on behalf of your employees are considered fringe benefits and can be classified as a business expense as an employer. As a result, if you pay the entire premium payment, you can take advantage of the group mediclaim policy tax benefit on the entire amount. Group health insurance benefits the organization because you can save money on taxes while still caring for employees. 7. Protect employees from severe health conditions As per a research publication in “Body Burden: Lifestyle disease”, lifestyle-related disorders account for more than 61% of hospitalizations and deaths in India. You can protect your staff from these and other ailments with group health insurance. It will help your employee identify these problems sooner. The sooner these problems are identified, the sooner they may be treated and resolved. 8. Improve the employees’ mental health Financial pressures stemming from medical expenses often lead individuals to experience significant stress, ultimately resulting in low productivity levels within the workplace. However, with the correct support, a group medical insurance plan will protect their finances, reduce their stress and improve their general mental well-being. 9. Boosting goodwill In today’s world, any company must have a good reputation inside and outside the organization. A compelling set of corporate group health insurance benefits, in addition to a good workplace environment and growth rate, ensures that the organization’s overall goodwill in the market grows. Limitations and exclusions in group health insurance policies Here are some common limitations and exclusions under group medical insurance coverage: Diseases caused by excessive alcohol consumption, smoking, tobacco consumption, or vaping are usually not covered. Pre-existing conditions may be excluded or covered only after a specified waiting period. Cosmetic treatments such as plastic surgery, Botox, or dermal fillers are not covered under group health insurance, unless required due to an accident. Mental illness and substance abuse-related treatments may be excluded in some group medical insurance policies. Expenses arising from self-harm or suicide attempts are not covered. Dental, eye, and ear treatments are excluded unless caused by an accident. Maternity and newborn expenses are covered under group health insurance only after a waiting period, while infertility treatments and abortion are excluded. Difference between group health insurance and individual health insurance Group health insurance covers a group of people, usually employees of an organization, while individual health insurance covers a single person or family. Individual health insurance typically offers a higher sum insured, whereas group medical insurance plans have a fixed and often lower sum insured decided by the employer. Additionally, individual plans usually provide more comprehensive coverage across a wider range of illnesses and treatments. Group medical insurance coverage may have certain limitations and exclusions. Premiums for individual health insurance are generally higher due to broader coverage, while group medical insurance premiums are lower and more affordable. Renewal terms for group health insurance Group health insurance usually has short policy terms based on the employer’s or group head’s requirements. The employer or group administrator must renew the policy once it expires. However, renewal depends on whether the covered members are still part of the organization or group at the time of renewal. Customization options and add-ons Employers or group heads can customize the group health insurance plan based on their group’s needs. They can decide the number of people covered, opt for specialized coverage, and add riders to enhance the plan’s benefits. They can also choose a suitable policy tenure, subject to the insurer’s terms and conditions. To end Group medical insurance plans are among the most affordable types of health insurance plans available. Group health insurance benefits both the employers as well as the employees. So, if you wish to invest in group health insurance, opt for Tata Capital to cover your employees’ various health needs. Make your employees’ future secure. Visit our website to know more. Apply for group health insurance now! Popular Searches group medical insurance for employees FAQs What is group health insurance, and how does it differ from individual health insurance? Group medical insurance covers a group of people connected through employment or an association and is offered by the employer or group head, while individual health insurance is purchased by individuals to cover themselves or their families. Who can be included under a group health insurance policy in India? In India, group health insurance can include employees of the same organization, their dependents, and members of recognized groups such as professional, cultural, sports, or other registered associations. Are pre-existing conditions covered under group health insurance in India? Pre-existing conditions may be covered under group health insurance in India. However, there may be a short waiting period before a claim can be made for the treatment of such diseases, depending on the policy terms. Can family members of employees be covered under a group health insurance policy? Yes, many group health insurance policies allow employees to include dependent family members such as a spouse, children, and parents, subject to the policy terms. What are the tax benefits available for employers and employees under group health insurance? Under group health insurance, employers can claim premiums as business expenses under Section 37 of the Income Tax Act, while employees contributing to the scheme can claim deductions under Section 80C for their share. What is the minimum number of members required for group health insurance in India? In India, group health insurance requires a minimum of 20 members for large organizations or groups, while small groups can enroll with at least 5 members. Insurance Medical Insurance Other Insurance Wellness solutions Home Insurance Travel Insurance Investment Mutual Fund If you wear glasses, you’re well aware of the problems that come with them. You can’t play sports with them on. Besides, sweat or vapour can make wearing them inconvenient. Contacts might solve the wearability problem, but they also require constant maintenance. This is why you might have considered getting surgery to correct your vision in the first place. And if you’re like most people, you’re probably considering getting LASIK (Laser-assisted in situ keratomileusis) surgery. This blog covers all you need to know about the surgery and tips on financing the operation. Let’s get right into it. What you should know about LASIK surgery LASIK laser eye surgery uses a laser to improve vision and is known to solve conditions like nearsightedness, astigmatism, and farsightedness as well. Usually a 30-minute procedure, LASIK surgery helps most people gain nearly perfect vision. The only caveat? It is often costly, and getting one done requires some financial planning on your part. So, how much does the LASIK laser eye surgery cost? Well, read on to find out. LASIK surgery cost in India varies depending on where you get the surgery done, the professionals doing it, the location, the facilities used, and much more. On average, the LASIK laser eye surgery can cost between Rs. 35,000 and Rs. 1,35,000 for both eyes. And that alone drives most people away from getting the surgery. Thankfully, there are ways to finance LASIK surgery without burning a hole in your pocket. Let’s explore a few of them. Also, read – How To Apply For A Quick Medical Loan For Health Emergencies? Why Get LASIK Surgery? Getting a LASIK eye surgery offers many benefits, such as: Life Without Glasses: One of the biggest benefits of LASIK is that it frees you from depending on glasses or contact lenses. You don’t have to worry about broken frames, changing prescriptions, or the daily routine of wearing contacts. Better Quality of Life: LASIK can boost confidence, especially for people who travel, play sports, or work in roles where sharp vision is very important. It helps reduce stress and makes everyday tasks easier. Long-Term Savings: LASIK surgery can be slightly expensive upfront. However, it can be cheaper over time as you don’t need to spend regularly on eye tests, lenses, and frames. Also, read – Medical Loan For Cosmetic Surgery Factors Affecting LASIK Eye Surgery Cost in India Several factors influencing LASIK cost can change how much you pay for the procedure. These include: 1. Type of LASIK Technology Standard LASIK is usually cheaper than advanced options like Femto-LASIK, SMILE, or Contoura Vision. These advanced LASIK technology types cost more because they offer higher precision and use modern equipment. 2. Clinic and Surgeon Expertise Well-known clinics and highly experienced surgeons may charge more as you are paying for their skill, safety standards, and proven results. 3. Technology and Equipment Used Clinics using the latest scanners and lasers usually have higher pricing. This is because they treat a wider range of vision issues with better accuracy. 4. Package Inclusions The cost of LASIK in different cities and clinics can vary depending on what the package includes. For example, consultations, tests, surgery, follow-ups, etc. Make sure to check for hidden charges before selecting a clinic. Also, read – Bridge Loan in India List the options available to cover the LASIK surgery cost in India #1. Debit card monthly instalments One of the easiest ways to cover the high LASIK surgery cost in India is through debit card monthly instalments. So, check if your bank allows debit card EMI payments. Usually, the details of this facility are readily available on your banking partner’s website. Debit card EMIs have several benefits, including no-charge EMIs, minimal documentation, and instant disbursement of funds. The caveat? These often come with spending limits. So ensure you have a sufficient spending limit to cover the LASIK surgery costs. #2. Credit card monthly instalments Another way to cover LASIK surgery costs in India is to use a credit card EMI facility. Here you can pay for the LASIK eye surgery procedure in the form of monthly instalments using your credit card. Once again, you’ll find all the details you need to make this conversion, as well as the terms of the payment on your banking partner’s website. #3. Employer assistance If you work at a reputed company that bears medical expenses from time to time, check with your company’s HR if the employer assistance covers LASIK surgery costs in India as well. This way, you won’t have to burn a hole in your pocket in order to correct your vision. #4. Medical loan The last and perhaps the most effective way of financing your LASIK surgery cost in India is through a medical loan. And here’s why. Unlike debit card or credit card EMI facilities, these don’t have any spending limits attached to them. So, you can get a medical loan to cover your LASIK eye surgery procedure, medication, and aftercare costs. Besides, today you can apply for a medical loan online at any reputable financial institution. The application process is quick and easy, and many banks have easy-to-meet eligibility requirements. All you need to do then is furnish the necessary documents to get the loan amount approved. Once that is done, the funds are swiftly disbursed to your linked bank account. It’s really that simple! Now that you know the various ways to cover your LASIK surgery costs, just choose the mode you prefer to pay for it. However, if you’re looking for a reputed medical loan provider to cover your LASIK eye surgery and aftercare, turn to Tata Capital . We offer all-inclusive medical loans that cover hospitalisation costs, LASIK surgery costs, and even post-care costs. The best part? However, some premium policies may offer partial coverage if your refractive error is very high. Make sure to check your policy details or speak with your insurer. Insurance Medical Insurance Other Insurance Wellness solutions Home Insurance Travel Insurance Investment Mutual Fund Land record maintenance was seen as a troublesome issue for decades. A majority of record-keeping centres were plagued with problems of mismanagement, lack of transparency, and data manipulation. Even the citizens were troubled, as any trivial land-related information would require a trip to the local tehsil and a waiting period of a few hours. Thankfully, India’s digital boom emerged as our savior from this predicament. With the majority of government services getting digitized, citizens can now access land records easily through digital portals. Devbhoomi Uttarakhand, also known as Bhulekh, is a website that serves this very purpose. Read on to unravel the workings of this website and find out the various services you can avail of through the Bhulekh Uttarakhand portal. Purpose and importance of land records in Uttarakhand Uttarakhand or Devbhoomi land records are official documents that show details about land ownership, boundaries, land type, and usage. They are of crucial importance to verify legal proof of ownership and rights over land. The state government maintains Devbhumi land records to properly manage land and collect land revenue. The records help resolve land disputes and plan development activities. Accurate land records make buying, selling, or inheriting land easier and more transparent for citizens. The following reasons highlight the importance of Devbhumi land records: Provide legal proof of land ownership Help prevent land disputes and fraud Make property buying and selling safer Support easy access to bank loans and subsidies Assist the government in land planning and taxation Help farmers claim benefits and compensation Ensure transparency in land administration Devbhoomi Bhulekh maintains efficient land records. As a result, it protects buyers and landowners and supports orderly development in the state. What is the Devbhoomi land records (Bhulekh Uttarakhand) portal? Established by the Uttarakhand Revenue Department, Bhulekh Uttaranchal is a user-friendly online platform that allows users to access land records in a digital format. The goal of this switch was to opt for an efficient approach that could enhance transparency and reduce instances of data manipulation and corruption. Furthermore, the online interface offers easy and convenient access to land records and saves valuable time for the citizens by eliminating the need for physical visits. The website offers a range of government services like Record of Rights, mutation details, Bhulekh maps, and Khasra Khatauni details. Key services offered on the Devbhoomi land records portal The Devbhoomi Bhulekh UK website provides a range of online services to simplify access to land records for the state’s citizens. Some of the key services available on the Bhulekh Uttaranchal portal include: Record of Rights (ROR): This feature enables users to view comprehensive details about land ownership, cultivation rights, and other associated rights. Mutation details: This service allows for easy access and updating of land ownership changes, such as transfers due to sales, inheritance, or other reasons. Bhulekh maps: The website offers access to land maps, crucial for understanding geographical layouts, land parcel boundaries, and more. Khasra Khatauni: Users can find information regarding Khasra (land parcel) and Khatauni (landowner) records. This is crucial for insights into land ownership, area, and related records. Svamitva status: The site also features a service to verify Svamitva status. This feature encompasses details on the total property count in a particular tehsil. Live tehsil status: Users have access to the current status of tehsils, which includes updates on the total number of online or offline tehsils present in a specific district. How to check khasra khatauni in the Devbhoomi Uttarakhand portal: Step-by-step To check the khasra khatauni details of your property, follow these steps: Step 1: Open your web browser and go to the official Bhulekh Uttarakhand website. Step 2: On the homepage, search for ‘Public ROR’. Upon clicking, you will be navigated to a separate web portal. Step 3: Enter the details of the district, tehsil, and village name of the desired property. Step 4: Enter other details like the Khasra number to refine your search. Step 5: Next, you can either click on the ‘By Registry’ or ‘By Name’ option to refine your search. Step 6: Once you enter the accurate credentials, you will receive the Khasra and Khatauni details of your property. How to check SVAMITVA status online? To check the Svamitva status on the Devbhoomi Bhulekh Uttarakhand website, follow these steps: Step 1: Open your web browser and visit the Bhulekh Uttarakhand official website. Step 2: On the homepage, search for the option related to Svamitva status. Step 3: You will be displayed a window showing the details of each district, tehsils, and more information. Step 4: In case you want details about a particular tehsil, you can click on it. Step 5: The portal will display the Svamitva status for the given tehsil, allowing you to view the relevant property count of every village in that tehsil. How to access Dehradun land records online? To access Dehradun land records on the Bhulekh Uttaranchal website, follow these steps: Step 1: Navigate to the Bhulekh Uttaranchal official website. Step 2: On the homepage, search for the option ‘Public ROR’. Upon clicking it, you will be redirected to another portal. Step 3: Once the new portal opens, select Dehradun in the district and tehsil column. You can then add the village name where the land is situated. Step 4: Next, you will be prompted to fill in specific details like Khasra number, registry number, account number, and more. Step 5: Upon successful filling of details, the portal will display the required Dehradun land records. How to check the tehsil status in Bhulekh Uttarakhand? To view the Tehsil status on the Bhulekh Uttaranchal website, follow these steps: Step 1: Open your web browser and visit the official Bhulekh Uttaranchal website Step 2: On the homepage, look for the option to check the Tehsil status. Step 3: Click on the Tehsil status option to go to the portal where you can see the current status of Tehsils in Uttarakhand. Step 4: Here, you will be displayed the live tehsil status, including details like district name, total number of tehsils, online tehsils, and offline tehsils. How to file corrections or disputes in land records? If you find any errors in the Devbhoomi land records, you must get them rectified to ensure accurate ownership and property details. The examples of some errors in land records include missing names, spelling mistakes, or wrong measurements. Follow the steps given below to rectify the errors or disputes: 1. Collect supporting documents such as the sale deed, registry papers, or inheritance proof. 2. Visit the local tehsil or revenue office where the land is registered. 3. Submit a written application explaining the error or dispute clearly. 4. Attach copies of all required documents to the application. 5. Pay the applicable correction or verification fee. 6. Attend hearings or field verification if requested by officials. 7. Track the application status until the correction is updated. Common reasons to access Bhulekh Uttarakhand People access Devbhoomi UK for various land-related services online. A list of the common reasons citizens, buyers, and farmers access Devbhoomi Uttarakhand is as follows: Check land ownership details View khata, khasra, and land records Verify the land before buying or selling Track changes or corrections in records Use records for loans or government schemes Reduce visits to revenue offices Conclusion Bhulekh Uttaranchal web portal is the next step towards a future of digitized and efficient record-keeping. Offering numerous government services from the comforts of your home, Bhulekh Uttaranchal has redefined accessibility, transparency, and reliability in acquiring land-related information. To check land records in Uttarakhand, visit the Bhulekh Uttarakhand portal and search for it online. Select your district and tehsil/block, then enter details such as the Khasra or Khatauni number. Once the information is entered, you can view, print, or download the land records if available. Is there a registration process to view land records on Bhulekh UK? Viewing basic land records on the Bhulekh Uttarakhand portal does not require registration. Users can directly enter relevant details to access land records without needing to create an account. How can I check my land map in Uttarakhand land records? To view the land map in Uttarakhand- Go to the official Bhulekh Uttarakhand portal. Choose the district, tehsil, and village where the land is located. Select the search option by Khasra or Khatauni number. Enter the relevant number and click submit. The land map, including boundaries and property details, will be displayed. You can also download the map if needed. What is the purpose of Bhulekh Uttarakhand? The Uttarakhand Government introduced the Bhulekh Uttarakhand portal to simplify access to land records, making it easier for people to check property details online. What are the charges to see Bhulekh UK? The Bhulekh Uttarakhand portal allows users to view basic land records free of cost. However, certain services, such as obtaining certified copies or detailed reports, may involve a fee. What is the Devbhoomi Bhulekh Uttarakhand portal and how does it work? Devbhoomi Bhulekh Uttarakhand is the state government’s online land records portal. It provides easy access to official records. Users can search land details by district, tehsil, village, and owner name. What details are needed to check Uttarakhand land records online? To check Uttarakhand Devbhoomi land records online, you need details such as district, tehsil, and village name. You also need the khata number, khasra number, or landowner’s name. Make sure the details are correct to generate accurate search results. How can I download my Khatauni or Khasra copy from the Devbhoomi portal? You can download your Khatauni or Khasra copy by visiting the Devbhoomi Bhulekh portal. Select land record options and enter the required details. The record will appear on your screen. The option to download is also available here. How to apply for mutation of land records in Uttarakhand? To apply for mutation in Uttarakhand, you must submit an application at the local tehsil or through the online land services portal. The application must be supplemented with a sale deed and inheritance proof. A fee is also levied on the service. Make the payment and track the status of the land record update. What should I do if I find errors in my Bhulekh land record? If you find errors in your Bhulekh land record, visit the local revenue or tehsil office. Submit a correction application with supporting documents. Insurance Medical Insurance Other Insurance Wellness solutions Home Insurance Travel Insurance Investment Mutual Fund Cosmetic surgery has gained immense popularity in India over the years. People from all walks of life are now opting for various cosmetic procedures like liposuction, breast augmentation, rhinoplasty, and more. However, these procedures can be quite expensive, and most insurance companies do not cover them. So, how can you finance your cosmetic surgery? The answer lies in a medical loan for cosmetic surgery. In this article, we will explore the benefits of a medical loan for cosmetic surgery and guide you on how to apply online. With Tata Capital’s medical financing options, you can turn your dreams of enhancing your appearance into reality. What is a Medical Loan for Surgery or Cosmetic Surgery? A medical loan is essentially a type of personal loan that you can avail of specifically for financing medical treatments or procedures. It provides you with the necessary funds to cover the costs of cosmetic surgery, which can often be substantial. Benefits of Medical Loan for Cosmetic and Plastic Surgery in India Use of funds: One of the major advantages of taking a personal loan for cosmetic surgery is that there are no restrictions on how you can use the funds. You have complete freedom to utilize the loan amount as per your requirements. Flexible repayment tenure: The cost of cosmetic surgeries can range from thousands to lakhs of rupees. With a medical loan, you have the flexibility to repay the amount over a period of five to seven years, depending on your financial situation. Pocket-friendly EMIs: Personal loans come with affordable interest rates and pocket-friendly EMIs. By using Tata Capital’s Personal Loan EMI Calculator , you can estimate your monthly repayments and choose a loan amount that fits within your budget. Quick and hassle-free process: Applying for a medical loan for cosmetic surgery is simple and convenient. With Tata Capital, you can apply online and get approval within minutes. The required funds are then disbursed directly into your bank account, enabling you to settle your surgery bills conveniently. No collateral required: Medical loans are unsecured loans, which means you don’t need to provide any collateral or security against the loan amount. This makes it easier for individuals to avail of the loan without worrying about putting their assets at risk. Also,read – How To Apply For A Quick Medical Loan For Health Emergencies? Eligibility Criteria for Medical Loan for Surgery/Cosmetic Surgery 1. Age: You must be between 21 and 58 years old at the time of the last EMI date or retirement age, whichever is later. 2. Monthly income: You should have a minimum monthly income of Rs. 15,000. 3. Work stability: Salaried employees should have a minimum work experience of one year and should be working in their current company for at least six months. Required Documents for Cosmetic/Plastic Surgery Medical Loan 1. ID proof: Aadhaar Card/ Passport/ Driving Licence/ Voter ID. 2. Income proof: Last six months’ salary credits or primary bank account statements. 3. Address proof: Aadhaar Card/ Passport/ Driving Licence/ Voter ID. 4. Salary slips: Copy of your salary slips for the last two months. 5. Employment certificate: A certificate stating continuous employment of one year. Plastic Surgery Loan Interest Rates & EMI Calculator The interest rates for medical loans for surgery will differ based on the loan amount, lender policies, and the borrower’s profile. For example, borrowers with high credit scores and good credit history may be able to avail lower interest rates. It is best to research multiple lenders and policies to find one best suited to your financial requirements. An EMI calculator is a handy tool when looking for cosmetic surgery loans. They help estimate monthly personal loan repayments by adjusting loan amount, interest rate, and tenure, making it easier to assess affordability, compare offers, and plan your budget accurately. Try Tata Capital’s EMI calculator today! Types of Cosmetic Surgeries & Treatments You Can Finance with a Medical Loan Loans for cosmetic surgery may be used to finance a wide variety of procedures. These could include, among others: Rhinoplasty Face lifts Tummy tucks Liposuction Breast augmentation Chemical peels Bariatric surgery They could also cover the costs of medication, post-operative care, and other expenses beyond the procedure itself. However, different lenders may have different policies regarding personal loans for plastic surgery, and which procedures will be covered under medical or personal loans. It is crucial to check which procedures are covered under personal loans for surgeries. Check multiple lenders to see which ones suit your requirements! Also,read – How to Finance your Lasik Eye Surgery? How to Apply for a Medical Loan for Surgery Online? (Step-by-Step) If you’re seeking plastic surgery financing, here are the steps to follow: Research and compare lenders : Reviewing different lenders, comparing interest rates, loan amounts, tenures, and charges can help you find an option that best fits your financial needs. Prepare your documents : Keeping your identity proof, income details, bank statements, and other financial records ready will avoid delays. Review your credit score : A strong credit score greatly improves your chances of approval and helps secure better interest rates and repayment terms for your plastic surgery loans. Once you have selected a lender, collected your documents, and filled in the application form, submit your application online or at a nearby branch. Conclusion The popularity of cosmetic surgery in India has led to an increased demand for financing options that cater specifically to such procedures. A medical loan for cosmetic surgery offers numerous benefits like flexible repayment tenure, affordable EMIs , quick disbursal of funds, and no collateral requirement. With Tata Capital’s medical financing options, you can easily apply online for cosmetic surgery finance and turn your dreams into reality. Don’t let financial constraints hold you back from achieving the look you desire. Apply for a medical loan today with Tata Capital and embark on your journey towards self-enhancement. Ease Your Medical Expenses: Get a Quick and Easy Loan Today! Apply now FAQs Can I get a medical loan for plastic surgery financing in India? Yes, many financial institutions, including conventional public- and private-sector banks and NBFCs, offer medical or personal loans for elective procedures and cosmetic surgery. What is the typical interest rate range for cosmetic surgery loans? Interest rates for plastic surgery loans vary by lender and borrower profile. Lenders will take your credit history, income, and loan tenure and amount into account. Are there student loans or special financing for two-wheeler/cosmetic surgery together? No, student and two-wheeler loans generally cannot be used for cosmetic procedures. Cosmetic surgery and other procedures are usually financed using medical or personal loans. Do I need CIBIL/credit score for a medical surgery loan? Yes, lenders will usually check your CIBIL credit score to assess your repayment capacity. A higher score improves your approval chances and helps secure lower interest rates and favourable terms. How long does it take for cosmetic/plastic surgery loan approval & online disbursal? Loan approval depends on the lender’s policies and processes. Public banks generally take longer to process loans. In contrast, private banks and NBFCs have quicker approval times. What is the maximum loan amount available for cosmetic procedures in India? The loan principal amount will depend on the borrower’s income, credit score, and the lender’s own policies and criteria. The procedure’s costs will also affect it. Insurance Medical Insurance Other Insurance Wellness solutions Home Insurance Travel Insurance Investment Mutual Fund Health insurance serves as an asset in times of medical emergencies. However, just purchasing a policy is not enough. You must understand how to access insurance money in case of medical emergencies and treatments. For this, you must familiarize yourself with the medical insurance claims processing steps. Being unaware of the nitty-gritty of the health insurance claim process can make it difficult to get the claim money when needed, creating stress and panic during a medical emergency. But worry not. In this article, we’ll guide you through the healthcare claims processing steps to ensure a hassle-free experience. How to file a health insurance claim? You can file a claim for your medical expenses in two ways: – Cashless claim: It allows you to receive medical care at a network hospital without making any upfront payment. Depending on your policy terms and coverage, the insurer will directly coordinate with the hospital to settle the bill. – Reimbursement claim: This typically applies when you receive medical treatment at a hospital not a part of the insurer’s network. In this case, you have to pay for the expenses yourself and seek reimbursement from the insurer. Also, read – Which is Recommended, Individual or Corporate Health Insurance? Documents required for health insurance claims in India Now that you’ve understood the medical claim’s meaning, you must know how to complete a mediclaim application. Documents play a vital role in filing a medical claim. They allow the insurer to verify your treatment, expenses, and policy details. You must always submit clear and accurate documents. If your documents successfully prove your claim, your application is approved faster, and the chances of rejection are reduced. Therefore, remember to keep copies of medical and policy papers handy, especially during hospitalization or after discharge. The list of documents required for filing reimbursement medical claims in India is as follows: Duly filled and signed claim form Copy of health insurance policy or E-card Hospital bills with a detailed breakup Discharge summary from the hospital Doctor’s prescriptions and consultation notes Diagnostic test reports, such as blood tests or scans Pharmacy bills with payment receipts Identity proof of the insured person Canceled cheque or bank details for reimbursement Step-by-step procedure for filing a reimbursement health insurance claim When you visit a non-network hospital of your insurer, you can opt for a reimbursement claim. Here, you pay the bills first and then get reimbursed by the insurance provider. A reimbursement claim functions as a backup for cashless claims. Follow this step-by-step guide to make a reimbursement claim for your medical expenses: Step 1: Inform the insurer Even if you intend to file a reimbursement claim after the treatment, you must notify your health insurance provider as soon as the treatment begins at the non-network hospital. Step 2: Apply for a reimbursement claim Collect and fill out the reimbursement claim form for the application process. You can get it at the hospital’s insurance desk or submit an online form if the insurer offers the facility. Step 3: Collect the necessary documents Along with the claim form, you will also have to submit documents like original bills and receipts of hospital and medicines, hospital discharge card, policy copy or insurance card, reports of tests conducted during, pre-, and post-hospitalization, Medical Certificate, and prescriptions signed by the doctor, etc. Make sure you have the complete list of documents required in one place. Step 4: Submit the documents Submit the claim form along with all the documents online or offline. After receiving the documents, the insurer/TPA will verify them and reimburse the funds to your account. Also, read – Group Health Insurance: Meaning, How It Works, Benefits Step-by-step process for filing a cashless health insurance claim With the cashless claim facility, you can get medical treatment at any network hospital without worrying about the funds. Here’s how: Step 1: Know about your policy Carefully read the inclusions and exclusions of your health insurance policy to clarify what is covered and what is not. For instance, some insurers do not cover pre-existing diseases. Similarly, if you had diabetes before purchasing the policy and made a claim for diabetes treatment costs, the claim would be rejected. Thus, knowing the exclusions and inclusions will help avoid claim rejection and confusion. Step 2: Know the list of network hospitals The second step is to be aware of the network hospitals of your insurer. You must visit a network hospital to receive medical treatment via a cashless claim. Show your health insurance card to get admitted and receive treatment. Your insurance provider will directly settle the bills with the hospital. Since the cashless claim facility is only available for network hospitals, you must select an insurer with a wide network. Step 3: Inform your insurer Before getting admitted to the network hospital or starting treatment, inform the insurer about the procedure. You can do this through a dedicated helpline number or by filling out the pre-authorization form. Step 4: Fill out the pre-authorization form Collect the pre-authorization form from the hospital to proceed with your cashless claim. The TPA/insurer will help you fill it out. Here, while you are not required to submit documents like hospital bills or prescriptions, you will have to present your cashless health card and identification proof. Step 5: Submit the form After filling out the form, submit it to the insurance desk. The TPA will then process your application and send you a confirmation email. It will also send a letter authorizing the maximum treatment cost. Also, read – 6 Key benefits of insurance on loans Common reasons for health insurance claim rejection A health insurance claim can be rejected for various reasons. While it’s essential to learn how to claim medical insurance, it is also vital to know about the common reasons for rejection so that you can avoid them. Non-disclosure of medical history: Your claims may be rejected if you didn’t declare past illnesses while buying the policy. Policy lapse due to non-payment: If premiums are not paid on time, the policy becomes inactive. As a result, you are not eligible for medical insurance coverage. Claiming for excluded treatments: Cosmetic procedures or non-covered treatments are often excluded under policy terms. Incorrect or incomplete documents: Missing bills, reports, or wrong information can lead to claim rejection. Hospital not in network: If you go for treatment at a non-network hospital, it can cause a cashless claim rejection. Exceeding sum insured limit: Claims above the medical insurance coverage amount are not fully approved. Delay in claim submission: If you submit claims after the allowed medical insurance claim time limit, it can result in rejection. Tips for smooth health insurance claim settlement The following tips can teach you how to claim health insurance successfully: Read the policy carefully: You must be clear about your medical insurance coverage, exclusions, waiting periods, and claim process before encountering a medical emergency. Disclose medical history honestly: Inform the insurance company about all past illnesses and treatments while buying or renewing the policy. Choose network hospitals: Visit network hospitals to get cashless treatment and faster claim settlement. Inform the insurer on time: Make sure you notify the insurance company immediately in case of planned or emergency hospitalization. Keep all documents safe: Save bills, reports, prescriptions, the discharge summary, and payment receipts properly. Fill claim forms correctly: Enter accurate details and double-check information before submitting the claim. Submit claims within the deadline: Most insurers have a claim time limit. Make sure you send the documents within this limit. Follow up regularly: Track claim status and respond quickly if the insurer asks for more information. How to track your health insurance claim status? Here are the steps on how to check medical insurance status: Note down the claim reference or claim number given by the insurance company when you apply. Visit the insurer’s official website or mobile app. Log in using your policy details and claim number. Go to the “Claim Status” section to check updates. If you’re not comfortable with the online process, you can call the customer care number for assistance. Make sure you save all emails and messages from the insurer and regularly follow up until the claim is approved or settled. Also, read – Types Of Credit Insurance In India Who can help with claim disputes or escalations? Several experts can help you if your medical claim is rejected or delayed. You can start by contacting the insurance company’s customer care or grievance cell. Next, your insurance agent or broker can provide guidance on how to claim health insurance. If the issue is still not resolved, you can approach the insurer’s grievance officer. The Insurance Ombudsman is another professional who can help with your health insurance claim. You can reach out to them via email. The IRDAI also offers support to policyholders through its grievance portal. Key considerations to keep in mind while claiming your health insurance When it comes to the hospital insurance claim process, there are a few things that you must keep in mind to make informed decisions. These include: #1 The sum insured limit Based on your policy, you can only seek coverage up to a certain amount from your health insurance. If your medical bills exceed this limit, you will have to bear the additional expenses. Thus, when filing your health insurance claim, check the sum insured limit in advance to avoid any confusion. #2 Timeline There are specific timelines that you must follow to get your claim. In the case of a cashless claim, there is a deadline for submitting the pre-authorization form, which is typically 3-4 days before the treatment for a planned hospital visit. In the case of emergency hospitalization, the deadline is 24 hours post-hospitalization. If you don’t meet the deadlines, your claim can be postponed. #3 Validity of the policy You can only make a claim if your health insurance policy is active. Therefore, make sure to check its validity to experience an easy, unrestricted health insurance claim procedure. You can contact the insurer’s customer care and give them your policy details to check its status. Conclusion Health insurance helps you deal with hefty expenses comfortably in times of medical emergencies. But you must be well-versed with the medical insurance claims processing steps to reap the benefits of your policy. You must also carefully select the right insurer that provides 24/7 customer service and will guide you through the process. This is what we at Tata Capital do. We help you file a claim online and guide you through the process to ensure a seamless experience. Checkout Insurance on Tata Capital Popular Searches group medical insurance for employees FAQs Can health insurance be claimed immediately? Most health insurance policies have a waiting period of 2 to 4 years for certain claims, though this may differ between insurers. Always review the policy’s terms and conditions to understand the waiting period before purchasing. Can I claim my health insurance in any hospital? Health insurance can be claimed in all hospitals except those specifically excluded by the insurer. Cashless claims are available only in network hospitals, while non-network hospitals require you to pay first and apply for reimbursement. Can we claim 100% medical insurance? You can claim up to the sum insured of your policy, but sub-limits may apply for specific treatments. Additionally, some conditions may have a waiting period before they are covered. What is the maximum Mediclaim limit? Under Section 80D of the Income Tax Act, you can claim deductions of up to Rs 25,000 annually for premiums paid for yourself, your spouse, and dependent children. If the policy is for a senior citizen, the deduction limit increases to Rs 50,000 per year. What is the minimum amount for Mediclaim? Experts recommend a health insurance policy with a sum insured of Rs 5 to 10 lakh. However, it is essential to choose a coverage amount that suits your health needs and can comfortably cover medical expenses, as one amount may not fit everyone. What is the difference between cashless and reimbursement claims in health insurance? In a cashless claim, the insurance company pays the hospital directly, provided it is a network hospital. In a reimbursement claim, you pay expenses first and later get the money back from the insurer. What documents are required for filing a health insurance claim in India? The common documents required to file a medical claim in India include a filled claim form, hospital bills, discharge summary, doctor’s prescriptions, diagnostic reports, policy copy, ID proof, and bank details for reimbursement. How much time does it take to settle a health insurance claim in India? Health insurance claims are usually settled within 15 to 30 days after submitting all required documents. There can be delays if documents are missing or require verification. What are the common reasons for health insurance claim rejection? Your health insurance claim can be rejected due to non-disclosure of pre-existing illnesses, policy lapse, excluded treatments, incorrect documents, delayed submission, or claims exceeding the sum insured limit. Can I file a claim if treated at a non-network hospital? Yes, you can file a reimbursement claim if treated at a non-network hospital. In this case, you will need to pay the bills upfront and later submit all required documents to the insurer. What is the medical insurance claim time limit in India? Most insurers have a medical insurance claim time limit, requiring you to notify them within 24 to 48 hours of hospitalization. Besides, you must submit documents within 7 to 30 days after discharge. The time limit varies depending on policy terms. How do I track the status of my health insurance claim? You can track claim status online through the insurer’s website or mobile app using your claim number. You can also contact customer care or check updates via email or SMS. Insurance Medical Insurance Other Insurance Wellness solutions Home Insurance Travel Insurance Investment Mutual Fund Health and medical emergencies strike unexpectedly. They demand immediate attention and often put a strain on finances. This is why most people get health insurance to cover the surgical and medical expenses of their loved ones and themselves. If you are looking to get health insurance, you know that individual and corporate health insurance are two of the most popular types of health insurance options. So, which one should you choose? In this blog, we will explore the intricacies of individual and corporate health insurance to help you choose one that aligns perfectly with your requirements. What is individual health insurance? An individual or personal health insurance policy provides coverage for one person’s medical expenses related to surgeries and hospitalizations. Your premium for this policy depends on your age, medical history, and pre-existing medical conditions. How does individual health insurance work? Individual health insurance is a plan you buy to protect yourself. It is not purchased through your employer or a group. You reach out to an insurance company, explore its different plans, and after selecting one that’s appropriate for you, pay a premium. The premium is paid monthly or annually, depending on your preference. In return, the insurance company provides coverage against your medical costs, such as doctor visits, tests, hospital stays, and medicines. Under an individual health insurance policy, when you avail medical care services, you may first pay some costs yourself. This is a set amount, also known as a deductible. Insurance starts helping after you pay the deductible. You may also pay a small part of each bill, called a copay or coinsurance. After that, the insurance company pays the rest, based on your plan. Different individual plans offer different levels of coverage and cost. You must choose one that fits your health needs and budget. Benefits of individual health insurance If you have individual health insurance, you can enjoy the plan’s benefits as a single person. Individual health insurance is suitable for individuals with more significant health concerns or medical needs like hypertension, heart disease, cancer, and diabetes. This is because these insurance policies are usually customizable. So, you can get a health insurance policy covering your health issues if you research well. It may offer a broader network of healthcare providers based on your chosen policy. There is no upper age limit for renewing the policy, allowing continued coverage. When you choose an individual health insurance policy, you can claim tax benefits. For perspective, according to Section 80 D of the Income Tax Act 1961, the premium is deducted from your taxable income. This reduces your tax liability considerably. Many health insurance companies offer no-claim bonuses if insurers do not file an insurance claim for the financial year. This way, you get returns from your insurance despite not claiming it. Limitations of individual health insurance While personal health insurance covers most health expenses, it doesn’t factor in all of them. For instance, co-payments or payments, like for doctor visits or prescription medications, may not be covered under your policy. Similarly, medical expenses at out-of-network hospitals or special procedures like cosmetic treatments or therapies may not fall under the purview of your policy. In such cases, you may be spending money out of your pocket despite having health insurance. If you want to offer health insurance coverage to your loved ones, you will need to get a family health insurance policy. If you do not have specific health concerns, you might be unable to maximize individual insurance policy features. This might mean you may pay a higher premium than the benefits you get. Individual health insurance policies may have a waiting period after which you can raise a claim for pre-existing health conditions. This means you can claim insurance coverage only when the waiting period ends. What is corporate health insurance? Corporate health insurance is offered by the organization to its employees. The biggest difference compared to individual health insurance is that the employer pays the premium here. This means that the insurance coverage will depend on the policy chosen by the employer. Note that some corporate health insurance policies may also include coverage for their family members, depending on the organization’s policies. How does group health insurance work? Group health insurance is a health plan offered to a group of people, usually by an employer, school, or organization. You join the group plan instead of buying insurance on your own. The cost is often lower because the risk is shared among many people. In most cases, the employer pays part of the monthly premium, and the employee pays the rest. With corporate group health insurance , the plan helps cover medical expenses such as doctor visits, hospital care, medicines, and preventive services. When you use medical services, you may need to pay a small amount, like a copay or coinsurance. Some plans also have a deductible. It is easy to join group plans. They offer basic coverage for many health requirements. As a result, they are a popular choice for professionals and their families. Benefits of corporate health insurance Unlike individual health insurance policies, you need not wait for a specific period before you can avail of corporate insurance benefits. Processing claims for medical expenses is uncomplicated in the case of corporate health insurance. This is because companies typically have tie-ups with hospitals to streamline claim settlement. Depending on your company, the insurance may cover OPD, preventative healthcare, mental health, and more. Limitations of corporate health insurance You will lose access to the corporate health insurance provided by your employer when you quit your job. Corporate health insurance plans are not customizable to fit your personal or family needs. They depend on your organization’s terms. Because corporate health insurance is tied to your job, switching jobs or experiencing a break in employment may leave you temporarily uninsured. Besides, it might be challenging to purchase individual health insurance due to coverage gaps. Unlike individual health insurance, corporate insurance offers no tax benefits. Some corporate insurance policies may not account for the hospitalization costs in metro cities. This means you might have to pay out of your pocket despite insurance. Corporate health insurance vs Personal health insurance Area of consideration Corporate health insurance policy Personal/individual health insurance policy Premium cost The premium cost of corporate insurance is usually low. Besides, the company covers these costs. The premium cost might be slightly high. Individuals usually pay for these costs from their savings. Coverage The coverage provided is limited. The coverage is comprehensive since most insurance companies allow customization. Customization Corporate health insurance offers coverage based on your employer’s provided plan and cannot cater to your personal and family needs. Individual health insurance can be tailored to suit your specific medical needs. No-claim bonus (NCB) Corporate insurance policies offer benefits only when you make a claim. You can enjoy the benefits of a no-claim bonus (NCB) on your individual insurance plan, depending on your policy. Job limitation Corporate health insurance becomes invalid once you leave the company, and there will be no coverage after retirement from the job. Individual health insurance plans do not expire when you leave your job. Corporate health insurance vs Personal health insurance: Which is better? There is no right answer to the above question, because the best insurance policy for you depends on your needs. So, compare plans from various providers to find the best fit for you. In this regard, Tata Capital Moneyfy can be your trusted partner. We offer both individual and corporate insurance, provide the best offers, and make the application process easy for you. Visit the Tata Capital website to apply for your insurance or download the Moneyfy app from the Play Store or App Store. How to choose the right health insurance policy? Personal circumstances and needs Analyze your situation, including age, marital status, dependents, health condition, and pre-existing conditions, to determine which insurance provides all the required features. Ask questions like: Do I have any specific medical conditions that need special insurance coverage? Do I have any pre-existing conditions that may affect how quickly I can claim insurance? Do I have dependents that need insurance coverage? Does my employer (or my loved one’s employers) provide health insurance? Cost Conduct a thorough cost analysis of premiums, co-payments, and out-of-pocket expenses for both individual and corporate health insurance. Consider your budget and choose the value for money option. Benefits and coverage requirements Review and compare the benefits and coverage offered, including preventive care, hospitalization, medications, specialists, and additional dental and mental health services. Accessibility and convenience Evaluate the network of healthcare providers, geographical coverage, claims processing, and customer service support each plan offers. Choose a plan that offers convenience and a seamless healthcare experience. Read more about health insurance on the TATA Capital MoneyFy website. Popular Searches group medical insurance for employees FAQs What is the difference between corporate and individual health insurance? Corporate health insurance is provided by an employer to employees. It is usually more affordable. Individual health insurance is bought personally and offers more choice and long-term coverage. Can employees continue their corporate health insurance after leaving the company? In most cases, company health insurance ends when you leave the job. Some insurers may allow conversion to an individual plan, but terms, benefits, and costs may change. Is it advisable to have both corporate and individual health insurance policies? Yes, it is advisable to have both policies. You can take care of basic healthcare requirements with corporate medical insurance. At the same time, you can use individual health insurance for extra protection, higher coverage, and continuity even if you change jobs. How do tax benefits differ for individual and corporate health insurance policies in India? Individual health insurance premiums qualify for tax deductions under Section 80D. Corporate health insurance premiums paid by employers do not offer direct tax benefits to employees. What happens if you exhaust your corporate health insurance coverage mid-year? If your corporate group health insurance limit is fully used, you must pay the remaining medical costs yourself. Alternatively, you can use your individual health insurance policy, if you have one. Can dependents be covered under both policies at the same time? Yes, dependents can be covered under both policies. In case of a claim, one policy is used first, and the other can cover remaining eligible expenses.
